choice_data_list_en: Sorry... I couldn't help you win.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
For one thing, I don't believe for a
second that
we wasted our time by
attempting this race... It is
a shame, but
there's nothing to be glum about.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There's always the next race, after all!
Besides, I
don't have time to be
wallowing in regret.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Sure, losing is frustrating, but still! Being
able to
run and compete against others
is just so
wonderful... It's so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list_en: I see, that's just like you.
I see, that's so like you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Besides, losing just means that I still
have plenty
of potential left to tap
into! ♪
